resources.string: First time? Use the admin email and password configured in your config.
Could not reach the server. Please check your connection.
The server returned an error. Please try again in a moment.
The server is not configured correctly. Please contact the administrator.
Something went wrong. Please try again.
Top events and screens show what your users do most. The daily chart tracks volume trends over the selected time window. All data is aggregated — no individual user is exposed.
Raw event log in reverse chronological order. Each row represents one analytics event fired by the SDK. Use this to inspect props, screens, and metadata when debugging your integration.
Manage your projects and API keys. Each project has a unique API key — create separate projects for different apps, environments (dev/staging/prod), or platforms.
Toggle demo data for testing in debug mode. The demo switch only appears when the server runs in debug configuration. Production deployments hide this by default.

Screen transitions show how users navigate your app. Each row represents one common path from one screen to the next, grouped by session. High drop-off at a step may indicate UX friction — investigate why users leave at that point.
Incoming events in real time. This feed auto-refreshes every few seconds to show the most recent events. Useful while integrating the SDK — watch events appear seconds after they fire in your app.
